ED_Title: Participation of non‑governmental organizations, civil society organizations, relevant medical organizations, academic institutions, the scientific community and the private sector in the high-level meeting on improving global road safety
ED_DecisionText:
At its 93rd plenary meeting, on 25 June 2026, the General Assembly, on the proposal of its President, (Footnote: A/80/L.78.) recalling paragraph 11 of its resolution 80/247 of 10 March 2026, entitled “Scope, modalities, format and organization of the high-level meeting on improving global road safety”, decided to approve the participation of the non‑governmental organizations, civil society organizations, relevant medical organizations, academic institutions, the scientific community and the private sector as listed in the annex to the present decision in the high-level meeting on improving global road safety, to be held pursuant to resolution 80/247.
